$comment: Skotizo (plugins/bosses/Skotizo.plugin.js, docs/skotizo.md). Ids are the rev 241 cache's; ticks count from the player's arrival at the catacombs altar, as in the rsprox captures (recordings 3323, 3329). Fields marked estimate in docs/skotizo.md have no capture behind them.

instance.$comment: Skotizo's lair is map square 9048 (2240-2303, 5632-5695), copied 8x8 chunks a plane, as captured.

ancientShardTeleports._source: Menu title and option labels: rsprox 3329 ("Where do you want to go? (1 shard)" and "Demons' Run|Dragons' Den|Reeking Cove|The Shallows"; four lines). Destinations: Wiki (Ancient shard#Destinations). The refusal line is recorded in full (rsprox 3314, 227/910489).
ancientShardTeleports.title: Where do you want to go? (1 shard)
ancientShardTeleports.noShard: You need at least 1 ancient shard to use the altar's teleportation powers.

altars.$comment: In the HUD script's order (west, east, south, north). Captured (rev 235) one tile further out; the rev 241 arena is smaller, so each sits just outside its wall's walkable edge (estimate).

exit.$comment: Not captured: the Wiki says the portals lead back to the catacombs; the tile is where captured players stood to use the altar.

ankou.$comment: Wiki: one at a time, off a random timer while an altar is awake. The range is an estimate.

catacombs.$comment: Wiki: every monster but ghosts in the Catacombs of Kourend and the Giants' Den; superior Slayer monsters always drop a piece.
